name: ByteCrawl
description: The focused-crawling MCP server for AI agents. Rank a whole site by your topic, read any page as clean Markdown, extract anything

paragraphs: Give your AI agent focused web crawling. ByteCrawl is an MCP server (and a small Python library) that doesn't just scrape a page — it crawls a whole site and returns the pages most relevant to your topic first, using Shark-Search and OPIC in pure Python.
Most crawlers visit pages in whatever order they find them. Under a request budget, order is everything. From en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SiliconValley with query san francisco, 20 pages each:
features: Latest release: 1.4.0 — clearer errors when a site's bot protection
Shark-Search (Hersovici et al., 1998) — topical best-first; links inherit
OPIC (Abiteboul et al., 2003) — live PageRank via "cash" flowing along
BFS — level by level. The honest baseline.
